subject: Sarah used you to fire her boss
preview_text: A user found a weird use for your app that I never saw coming
body_paragraphs: A few weeks ago, I got a message from a user named Sarah. She said your app helped her quit her job. I almost deleted it as a joke.
But she was serious. Her breakup had made her realize she was settling for a boss who treated her like her ex. She used your emergency mode to rehearse saying 'I quit' until she believed it.

That's when it hit me: Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy isn't just for healing after the split. It's for rebuilding the person you lost. Your mood tracker can catch when you're shrinking yourself in a job or friendship. Your journaling prompts can help you set boundaries you never knew you needed.

Try this: Open the app and go to your no-contact streak tracker. But instead of tracking your ex, write down one person or situation you've been tolerating. Then hit the emergency mode button and say what you'd tell them if you had no fear. Just once. See what happens. P.S. Sarah now runs her own design studio. Her ex? Still in the same apartment, same job, same regrets.
